result.instructions: MCP4SAS runs SAS code through SASPy using SAS OnDemand for Academics or a local SAS config. Use run_sas_codes_or_files_in_ODA for SAS code, .sas files, uploads, downloads, deletes, listings, and file metadata. Use saspy_cfgname=oda for SAS ODA, saspy_cfgname=linuxlocal/local/default for local Linux SAS, or saspy_cfgname=winlocal for local Windows SAS. Use run_local_sas_without_saspy only for direct one-shot local Linux/Windows SAS batch jobs without SASPy; it cannot keep a persistent SAS session. Long jobs return a PID; poll with {"pid": PID} no more than about every 30 seconds. Do not expose this local server to untrusted networks, and avoid placing SAS ODA passwords in prompts unless intentionally bootstrapping credentials.

tools.description: Submit SAS code or .sas files through SASPy. Use saspy_cfgname=oda for SAS ODA, linuxlocal/local/default for local Linux SAS, or winlocal for local Windows SAS through SASPy IOM. Supports persistent SASPy session reuse, ODA file upload/download/delete/list operations, and background status polling for long jobs.

archive_transfers.description: Truth-like value controlling ZIP batching for two or more uploads/downloads. Default: true.

check_saspy_connection_only.description: Truth-like value to validate the selected SASPy config with PROC SETINIT and exit.

classify_sas_log.description: Optional local SAS log to classify without submitting code. Space exhaustion exits 73; remote session termination exits 74.

cleanup_empty_output_dir.description: Truth-like value controlling removal of empty auto-created output directories. Default: true.

delete_dir.description: Remote directory scanned by delete_file_rgx. Default: ~.

delete_file.description: Optional remote SAS ODA file path, or list of paths, to delete.

delete_file_rgx.description: Optional regex pattern(s) for deleting remote files after listing delete_dir.

dir4listing.description: Optional remote SAS ODA directory to list, for example ~/Macros.

download_file.description: Optional remote SAS ODA file path, or list of paths, to download.

download_local_path.description: Optional local destination path(s), paired positionally with download_file.

file_info.description: Optional remote SAS ODA file path(s) to inspect.

kill_saspy_sessions.description: Truth-like value to stop local SAS ODA wrapper/session-server/Java bridge processes.

no_run_timeout.description: Truth-like value to disable the wrapper timeout.

output_file.description: Optional output text file used by the MCP status wrapper. Default: a retained SAS_Output_MCP4SAS_* result path.

persistent.description: Truth-like value to reuse a persistent SAS ODA session. Default: true.

pid.description: PID from a previous call. Supply it to poll status.

prompt_sas_oda_auth.description: Truth-like value to force SAS ODA credential refresh.

run_timeout_seconds.description: Optional wrapper timeout for a long SAS submit.

sas_codes_or_file.description: Raw SAS code or a local .sas file path. Preserve newlines and semicolons exactly.

sas_oda_account.description: Optional SAS ODA account/email for first-run credential bootstrap.

sas_oda_password.description: Optional SAS ODA password for first-run credential bootstrap.

saspy_cfgfile.description: Optional path to a SASPy sascfg_personal.py file.

saspy_cfgname.description: Optional SASPy config name, for example oda, linuxlocal, local, default, or winlocal.

session_id.description: Persistent SAS ODA session id. Default: mysession.

skip_upload_if_same.description: Truth-like value controlling remote size/timestamp reuse for uploads. Default: true.

upload_file.description: Optional local file path, or list of paths, to upload to SAS ODA HOME.

tools.description: Run SAS code or a .sas file with a local Linux SAS executable or local Windows sas.exe through RunLocalSASDirectly.sh, without SASPy. This is a one-shot batch runner with background PID polling only: persistent session reuse is not supported, and WORK data sets, macro variables, librefs, options, and loaded macros do not carry across tool calls. Use the SASPy-backed tool with saspy_cfgname=linuxlocal or winlocal when persistent local SAS session reuse is required and SASPy is available.

local_sas_exe.description: Optional local SAS executable path. Passed as MCP4SAS_LOCAL_SAS_EXE to RunLocalSASDirectly.sh.

local_sas_platform.description: Optional platform override for RunLocalSASDirectly.sh: linux or windows.

output_file.description: Optional MCP wrapper output text file. Default: a retained SAS_Output_MCP4SAS_* result path.

pid.description: PID from a previous direct local SAS call. Supply it to poll status.

sas_codes_or_file.description: Raw SAS code or a local .sas file path. This direct local SAS runner starts a fresh SAS process for each call.

tmp_sas_file.description: Optional internal temporary .sas file path used when raw SAS code is submitted.
